issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
'Rotate layers' lose points on items when select a item

**From Ian:** @lebaphi - let's remove the `Rotate layers` button, please.  It's not a feature we require.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. select 'Rotate Layers'
4. Notice each items has many points for rotate function
5. Select a item
6. Notice  points on items are dissapear

View below screencast for more details
## ⚙️ Expected behavior
'Points on items (for 'Rotate Layers' function )should not dissapear when select a item
## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/5dc19cdf-205f-4521-a66c-684053ca9923


## 💻 System information

 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
